items.name: ColumnTrie
items.summary: A trie (prefix tree) for efficient column path matching.

methods.name: contains_prefix_of
methods.summary: Returns true if `path` equals or is a descendant of any inserted column.

methods.name: from_columns
methods.summary: Builds a trie from a list of column names.

methods.name: insert
methods.summary: Inserts a column path into the trie.

methods.name: is_terminal
methods.summary: Returns true if `path` exactly matches a terminal (leaf) column in the trie.
